rules: Client static, runtime capture, legacy server, third-party, derived and Formal DB evidence are not interchangeable.
Formal DB presence does not prove Taiwan official authority.
No protocol guessing without official evidence.
No V2 promotion before its baseline and promotion gate exist.

systems.name: Login
systems.scope: 19/19/6 handshake, 208-byte LoginRequest and authenticated session path.
systems.gap: Failure variants and broader account-policy parity remain outside scope.

systems.name: Character List / Select
systems.scope: List, server selection, ownership reservation and World transfer.
systems.gap: Create, delete and rename live-client acceptance are not promoted.
systems.nextGate: Capture lifecycle variants only when selected as the active gap.

systems.name: World Entry
systems.scope: 10/10 World handshake and official 1772-byte bootstrap are verified. Formal World Login map identity/bounds coverage is 144/144 enabled official maps. Isolated 6002 LoginProbe verified map 170015007 identity/bounds validation and successful InWorld entry using the 1772-byte bootstrap without Portal wire projection.
systems.gap: 144/144 is Formal World Login identity/bounds coverage, not proof that the original Windows Client visually loads all 144 maps. The official 1772-byte bootstrap does not provide verified per-map World Entry projection semantics.
systems.nextGate: Run isolated original-client World Entry acceptance across multiple Area/Map identities; keep World Login identity coverage separate from Portal wire projection evidence.

systems.name: Movement
systems.scope: Sequence rejection, optional bounds and persistence.
systems.gap: Collision rules are incomplete for the full map catalog.
systems.nextGate: Bind validation to promoted collision evidence.

systems.name: Portal / Map Transition
systems.scope: Migration 475 restored all 5 evidence-backed Formal routes and 5 portal evidence rows. Migration 476 restored 65 disabled staging portal resource links. OfficialPortalWireCodec currently has 6 evidence-backed destination identities; this Portal wire evidence is independent of the 144/144 World Login Formal identity/bounds coverage.
systems.gap: Portal wire projection remains evidence-gated to 6 verified destination identities. This must not be generalized to 144/144 from World Login coverage. The 65 staging links still lack complete exact-client provenance and verified triggers; 68 legacy CAN-link candidates remain supplemental.
systems.nextGate: Validate Portal destinations and staging links only from exact-current or live-client evidence; do not infer PositionMode, PreludeState, MapTransitionFirst, or additional destination support from World Login coverage.

systems.name: Map Content / Hierarchy / Collision
systems.scope: Migration 114 exact-current static catalog is complete at 144/144 with zero missing formal rows. Migration 476 restored 158 client map resources, 144 resource identities and 65 portal resource links as disabled pinned staging provenance. Map 557790525 remains a separately classified verified runtime slice.
systems.gap: Exact-current client file hashes and navigation provenance remain incomplete. The restored staging rows are disabled and are not Taiwan live gameplay proof; hierarchy semantics and collision provenance remain unresolved.
systems.nextGate: Validate the restored staging rows against exact-current client files, then diff hierarchy, collision and portal references.

systems.name: NPC Spawn / Dialog
systems.scope: Pinned NPC 3793 spawn, dialog, selector, release and reopen.
systems.gap: Map 170015000 returned zero NPC snapshot rows; full NPC coverage is absent.
systems.nextGate: Diff NPC templates, spawns, map bindings and dialogs.
